name: Election type
description: What kind of election this is. Includes referendums and recalls — they're run and reported the same way as elections, even though no one is being elected to an office.

hasDefinedTerm.name: General
hasDefinedTerm.description: The regular election where offices are due to be filled.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Primary
hasDefinedTerm.description: An election to pick a party's candidates.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Runoff
hasDefinedTerm.description: A second round after the first round didn't produce a clear winner.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Special
hasDefinedTerm.description: An election called outside the normal schedule, usually to fill a vacancy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: By-election
hasDefinedTerm.description: An election for a single vacant seat, held partway through a term. The term used in Commonwealth countries for a special election.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Referendum
hasDefinedTerm.description: A question put directly to voters.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recall
hasDefinedTerm.description: A vote on removing an officeholder before their term ends.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Indirect
hasDefinedTerm.description: Chosen by an electoral college or a sitting body instead of by voters directly.
